config.label: Bearer <token>
config.description: Bearer <token>. The endpoint runs in OAuth mode: a client that speaks the OAuth flow needs no header at all and discovers the authorization server from the 401 challenge. A GitLab personal access token also works here, sent as 'Bearer glpat-...', which keeps clients with no OAuth flow working. It travels per request and is never stored server-side.
